Advantages of Mobilunity as a Provider of Dedicated AWS Developers

{additional services}

Additional AWS Services For Your Project Needs

Elastic Compute Cloud

Our AWS developers can help you integrate EC2 with other services like Elastic Load Balancing and Auto Scaling to ensure you run smoothly even during peak loads. Leverage the full potential of EC2 for launching a new web application, scaling the existing one, or optimizing your cloud infrastructure.

Simple Storage Service (S3)

Our team can ensure that your application is ready for managing vast amounts of data or hosting media content without disruption and under minimal manual intervention. Empower your project with efficient storage for automated scaling, storing and retrieving data, based on your data demands.

Relational Database Service (AWS RDS)

Use our development experts to set up and manage your databases, and automate time-consuming tasks (backups, patching, scaling, etc.) using popular engines like MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, and PostgreSQL. Optimize your performance, ensuring efficient data management and fast query processing.

Simple Queue Service (SQS)

Mobilunity’s talented AWS specialists can help you handle complex workflows, real-time data streaming, and batch processing – creating resilient and responsive AWS architecture for your business. Enable your apps to scale independently, allowing different services to communicate without bottlenecks.

Route 53

Engage our skilled AWS developers to configure Route 53 to work in sync with CloudFront, ELB, and other AWS services, creating highly available infrastructure with low latency. Implement DNS resolution, connecting user requests to your apps hosted on AWS, on-premises, and other cloud environments.

ElastiCache

Our certified AWS developers can set up ElastiCache to handle caching for dynamic content, session data, and database queries – ensuring your business performs efficiently even under peak loads. Improve your app’s speed, reduce latency, and greatly improve user experience. 

Elastic Container Service (ECS)

Mobilunity’s cloud experts can streamline your CI/CD pipelines, allowing your development teams to deploy updates faster and more efficiently. Run and scale containerized apps, microservices, or complex workflows without the need to manage your own infrastructure.

Load Balancer

Hire experts to manage high-traffic applications on AWS, optimize performance, and improve fault tolerance – this allows your infrastructure to grow dynamically and maximizes user satisfaction. Enhance your app’s performance and reliability by efficiently distributing traffic across your resources.
